description: The sizes and limits of an Implementer environment (#818): the VM sizes of the platform, the ones an environment may name, the memory the agent's container gets at each, and the bounds of the setup script. A data file: no schema, nothing refers to it. The Dispatcher (SANDBOX_VCPUS, agentMemoryMb and IMPLEMENTER_MIN_AGENT_MEMORY_MB in dispatcher/src/launchers/sandbox.ts) and the app (app/src/implementer/environments/limits.ts) each keep a typed copy that a test compares with this file. A size an environment names is launched only if it is in `vcpus` and leaves the agent at least `minAgentMemoryMb`: 1 vCPU is a size of the platform (reviews run on it) and leaves the agent nothing, so an environment cannot name it and a task whose environment still has it is refused.
